meta.title: A dormant-locked PR line can be pulled into an existing draft
gaps: No setup recipe creates a dormant, locked PR or an existing draft linked to that PR.
No operation or library case expresses pulling a dormant PR line into an existing draft.
The PR line number and dormant-lock state cannot be supplied using the available tokens and fields.
HTTP 422 code 1125 cannot be asserted without an operation that performs this pull.
